annotations.title: Token safety check ("is this a rug?")

description: Evidence-based risk check of one token: risk score and level (higher = riskier), fraud flags with their evidence, whether the mint policy is locked, liquidity depth and how much of the LP is locked or burned, holder concentration and what was not checked. Use it before calling a token safe.

unit.description: Token unit: 56-hex policy id followed by the asset name in hex (no separator). Get it from `search` or `list_tokens`.

name: get_token_safety
title: Token safety check ("is this a rug?")
